notes: Corrected French typescript, archive sheet number 113; no separate title, own page number, date or stated total count. It continues corollary 4 with geometric connectedness under properness and states Corollaire 5 on surjectivity of the displayed fundamental-group homomorphism, with a composite hypothesis number 3/4 and raised avec X propre. The formula is inline, continuing into est surjectif. The next paragraph asks for a non-generic statement, sans hypothèse de propreté, and larger quotients. Théorème 6 begins with k algebraically closed, X propre, a map to projective space, L_t and D; conditions a)–c) concern nonemptiness, smoothness/codimension and netness, and a boundary condition. The final paragraph assumes U=X-D irreducible and defines tame quotients; it ends at homomor-. The theorem's conclusion is not on this page and was not supplied or verified. The coexistence of sans hypothèse de propreté in the motivating paragraph and X propre in the theorem is preserved as written. No explicit authorial proof reservation is present. danonique, sous -espace and net remain literal. The upper opening word has p/i and p/t composite cells; the later opening repeats only the p/i cell, printed with inherited uncertainty under the recurrence rule. Four occupied internal cells in codime[m|n]tsion are retained without an inferred correction order. The cancelled grou is readable; the cancelled accent above ou remains uncertain. The mixed preposition before X remains e/s, n/u, r. Mathematical roles prompted inspection of the cancelled intersection, corrected objects, inequality, D subscript, extra pi mark and U/V argument; their ink decided the reading. Both U letters in the cancelled formula and U in Alors U_t are resolved; the intersection remains uncertain. The slanted lower inequality stroke changes the glyph shape only. The second pi carries an additional t/+ mark above its head, distinct from its right superscript, and its U/V argument is plain rather than an established double-struck letter. Three margin rules with visible tonal differences, a two-line slanted marginal reference, and two detached points below-left of the codimension object are retained geometrically, with maker/material unassigned. No separate display or diagram occurs. Every insertion and deletion has an inventory entry. H's bold headings and handwritten-identity wrapper differences alone are excluded; actual punctuation gaps and formula placement remain collation differences. The inherited prior question about the composite numeral referred generically to the previous page; it was not used as evidence and no other page was opened by these readers. No external reference chronology was used to resolve the marginal S C/G A or its final 11/II. No mathematical proof check, OCR, external research or LaTeX compilation was performed.
